sql: SELECT email FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) customers JOIN (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.customer_id, sluice_src.total_cents, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.placed_at, NULL AS email FROM shop.main.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $2) orders USING (email)
